name: edify-planning-tool
description: CSS build pipeline: compiles assets/css/tailwind.source.css (Tailwind v4 + custom.css) into the committed bundle static/css/main.css. Never edit main.css by hand.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i assets/css/tailwind.source.css -o static/css/main.css && tailwindcss -i assets/css/tokens.source.css -o static/css/tokens.css
